name: Linq
summary: A bluffing party game where two secret holders of the same word give clues to find each other while everyone tries to guess the pair.
rules_text: Players are dealt one hidden card per match: 2 identical LINQ word cards and the rest Bluff ??? cards. In two fixed clue rounds, going clockwise, each player says exactly one word as a clue to their card; LINQ holders may not say the LINQ word, any form of it, or a rhyme, otherwise the match is void. After Round 1 each player secretly writes on a guess sheet either the two suspected LINQ holders or No Guess, places it facedown, and may not speak about it. Round 2 repeats the clue. Anyone who guessed in Round 1 must write No Guess in Round 2; everyone guesses exactly once per match. Guesses are then revealed in clue order. Scoring: 3 points for correct pair guessed in Round 1, 2 points in Round 2, 1 point for a Bluff holder who guesses wrong. Both LINQ holders must correctly guess each other or neither scores. First to 10 points wins, playing extra matches to break ties.
rating_reason: Word bluffing game, hidden pair has LINQ, needs opponent modelling.
